content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment on us:

- **Fees are purely usage-based.** Section 3.1 obligates the Company to pay only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month. Payment tracks actual sales through the Site; the $11,000 threshold operates in our favor as a floor below which nothing is owed.
- **No take-or-pay, shortfall, or volume cap.** Targeted searches for "minimum", "commit", and "fee", plus a full read of all sections, surfaced no committed volume, shortfall make-whole, or restriction on our usage levels. HDI bears development, hosting, and promotion costs (¶¶ 1.2, 1.8).
- **Exit right exists.** Section 4.1 provides a one-year term with rolling annual renewals, terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice — satisfying even the fallback position.

One adjacent item noted but deliberately not redlined here: Section 4.2(a)'s Termination Payment ((trailing 12-month Net Sales − $800,000) ÷ 2) prices our exit. Because it is measured by sales actually achieved rather than by failure to meet a committed volume, it is not take-or-pay and falls outside this rule — it belongs to the termination-fee/early-exit rule, where the appropriate challenge can be made without duplicating findings.
